dct:title: S&P 500 Dividend Policy and Industry Profitability Analysis
dct:description: An end-to-end data pipeline project developed for the IS477 Course Project. The project integrates firm-level market data from Yahoo Finance and industry-level profitability benchmarks from NYU Stern to explore whether industry net margins predict corporate dividend behavior. The study fulfills the course requirement for data integration, quality assessment, and automated provenance.

dct:publisher.foaf:name: Grace Jiang
dct:publisher.dct:description: Responsible for data lifecycle (Module 1), cleaning (Module 10), integration (Modules 7/8), quality (Module 9), and reproducibility.

dct:publisher.foaf:name: Richard Li
dct:publisher.dct:description: Responsible for data collection (Module 3), ethical handling (Module 2), storage (Modules 4/5), metadata (Module 15), and workflow automation.

dcat:dataset.dct:title: Raw S&P 500 Dividend Data (Yahoo Finance)
dcat:dataset.dct:description: Firm-level financial data scraped via yfinance API. Includes Ticker, Payout Ratio, and Dividend Yield.

dcat:dataset.dct:title: NYU Stern Industry Margins (Damodaran)
dcat:dataset.dct:description: Industry-level profitability benchmarks (Gross, Operating, and Net Margins) compiled by Prof. Aswath Damodaran.
dcat:dataset.dct:rights: Publicly available for educational/research purposes with attribution preferred.

dcat:dataset.dct:title: Cleaned and Integrated Final Dataset
dcat:dataset.dct:description: The 'ground truth' analytical dataset containing 493 high-quality observations. Result of mapping Yahoo Finance industries to Damodaran categories and mitigating outliers.

dct:provenance.dct:title: OpenRefine Curation History (history.json)
dct:provenance.dct:description: The machine-readable JSON 'recipe' used to resolve semantic heterogeneity between industry labels.

dct:provenance.dct:title: Statistical Analysis Script (analysis_modified.py)
dct:provenance.dct:description: Generates the OLS regression results ($R^2 = 0.054$) described in project findings.
